scope: Nontransactional Intel BTF branch selection in protected legacy16/32 and generated paged x64 execution across the three recorded integration revisions.

archive.scope: Retained source snapshots, build receipts, frozen test binaries, raw logs, generated sources and compiled products. Initial development runs are retained separately and are not included in qualification counts.

counting: Each test execution is counted once in its declared SDK/core run. Original branch comparisons are counted separately; they do not imply complete machine-state or privilege-level qualification. The final integration repeats the focused matrix after the Capstone dependency update; these are additional executions of existing cases, not newly distinct instruction cases. Byte-copy unit comparisons are separate from x86 branch observations. The shared-source merge repeats the complete affected C-output suites and BTF matrix. Repeated executions across revisions are counted separately; the single LA57 skip belongs only to the original full legacy/paging suite. Publication synchronization adds 22 pure symbolic substitution/membership tests; it adds no original-instruction observations.

branch_selection.interface: Linux PTRACE_SINGLESTEP/PTRACE_SINGLEBLOCK over child-owned original instruction bytes
branch_selection.cases: Taken and untaken Jcc, zero-displacement branches, LOOP/LOOPE/LOOPNE, counter-zero branches and near CALL/RET; x64 also covers address32 loops with high RCX bits.
branch_selection.limits: Ptrace owns exception entry and normalizes TF. It does not provide raw debug frames, DEBUGCTL readback, supervisor behavior or task/transactional debug evidence.

software_contract: v1 refusal before validation, fetch or producer polling
BTF clearing for execution/data comparators, ICEBP and GD
Ordinary faults and software INT 1 retain BTF
Deferred external #DB retains BTF until acceptance
Entry faults and backing resume retain completed branch and cleared BTF
REP grouping receives raw TF and DEBUGCTL independently
oracles.kvm_btf: Accepted MSR writes read back as zero on this host; no raw BTF execution claim is made.
oracles.la57_skip: The local KVM CPU does not expose LA57. The skipped original five-level paging case is not counted as passed.

remaining: Full-machine BTF qualification, task/transactional debug, general i386/compatibility source dispatch and the other state/environment domains in x86-instruction-support.md remain separate work. No LLVM release, production SDK pin or LLVM gitlink update is made.

publication_integration.scope: Focused BTF matrix and full undefined/preserved audits on both SDKs after Capstone byte-copy update; added stack-observer static proofs; guarded upstream byte-copy unit. Earlier complete regressions retain their frozen dependency revision.
publication_integration.stack_observer_scope: Compilation and static optimized LLVM predicates across both C routes, scheduled/unscheduled and no-fault/paged/paged-debug modes. This is not native CPU or paging/debug-delivery proof.

capstone_copy.scope: Upstream byte-copy unit; all uint16_t lengths, short instruction lengths, source padding and guard boundaries. No performance claim.

publication_archive.scope: Capstone integration and its focused qualification before the later shared-source merge.

final_integration.scope: Shared source-emission, source ABI and HighIR integration. Both SDKs run complete paged-execution, continuation-export and undefined/preserved-state audits; BTF branch selection also repeats on both core types. The unchanged legacy runtime retains its earlier broad frozen regression scope.

final_integration_archive.scope: Final shared-source merge, frozen products and full affected C-output regressions on both SDKs. Earlier qualification phases retain their own tested revisions.

review: Android Binder changes do not enter the explicit x86 execution or source-emission owners.
The call-register proof bound narrows from 4096 to 1024 bytes and retains conservative unknown effects outside that bound; the deleted IR limit has no consumers.

For a single replaced variable, minimumVariableId > target implies absence. Other subtrees now traverse bottom-up, keeping identical nodes when operands did not change; simultaneous replacement semantics are unchanged.
publication_sync.focused_checks: Both SDKs rebuild the updated Symbolic library with NeverDSymBatchSubstitutionTests and NeverDSymbolicPredicateTests. Run all six batch-substitution cases and five substitution/membership predicates. Earlier BTF/export matrices retain their exact frozen revisions.

publication_sync_archive.scope: Late dev synchronization: unchanged BTF owners and C emitters, reviewed conservative call-proof limit, and focused checks for the changed symbolic substitution implementation. This stage does not rerun the earlier full BTF/export matrices.
